title: Battle of Bicocca
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Bicocca", at revision 1370107825, opens: "The Battle of Bicocca or La Bicocca was fought on 27 April 1522, during the Italian War of 1521–26. A combined French and Venetian force under Odet de Foix, Vicomte de Lautrec, was decisively defeated by an Imperial–Spanish and Papal army under the overall command of Prospero Colonna. Lautrec then withdrew from Lombardy, leaving the Duchy of Milan in Imperial hands." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q683341, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1522 battle of the Italian wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
